Rules are under Settings > View all settings > Fraud Tools > Card Verification Value (CVV) > Edit.
entries.quote: when the customer enters a CVV code that does not match the one on file at the customer’s bank, the system voids the transaction

entries.title: Payment declined by the fraud score threshold
steps: On the Essentials plan or higher the fraud score threshold is on by default and may block payments automatically.
When a payment is declined for this reason, a message shows on the merchant-facing screen.
To change the threshold: Settings > View all settings > Fraud Tools > Risk Score Threshold > Edit.
Choose High risk (default, declines only high scores), Medium risk or Low risk, or turn the toggle off, then Save.
entries.quote: When a transaction is declined based on your fraud score threshold, a message displays on the merchant-facing screens.

entries.title: Block or allow specific cards, emails or addresses for online payments
steps: Log in to the Clover dashboard.
Select Settings > View all settings.
Under Ecommerce, select Fraud Tools.
In Block List (or Allow List), select Edit, then Add for each rule.
An asterisk before or after a value matches anything containing it.
entries.quote: In Block List, select Edit and then select Add for each rule you’d like to set.

entries.title: Take a keyed payment in Virtual Terminal
steps: Log in to the Clover dashboard.
Select New Sale.
From Transaction Type, select Take Payment.
Enter the amount in the Subtotal field and select the tax.
For a phone or mail order, tick 'This is a mail or phone sale (MOTO)'.
Search for the customer or add a new one with their card details.
Choose the receipt: Email or None.
Select Complete Payment.
entries.quote: From the Transaction Type dropdown, select Take Payment.

entries.title: Use a USB magstripe reader with Virtual Terminal
steps: Plug the USB magstripe reader into a USB port on the computer.
In Virtual Terminal select Take Payment under Transaction Type.
Fill in the sale details.
Select the Card Number field and swipe the card. The number and expiration date fill in.
Select Complete Payment.
entries.quote: Under Payment Information, select the Card Number field and swipe the customer’s card in the card reader.

entries.title: Verify a card without charging it
steps: Log in to the Clover dashboard.
Select New Sale.
From the transaction type menu, select Verification.
Enter a name or email address.
Enter the card details.
entries.quote: From the transaction type menu, select Verification.

entries.title: Change Virtual Terminal settings
steps: Log in to the Clover dashboard.
Select Settings > View all settings.
Under Transactions, select Virtual Terminal.
Choose transaction settings (authorization, verification, tip, convenience fee, sales tax) and which customer fields to ask for.
Select Save.
entries.quote: Under Transactions, select Virtual Terminal. The Virtual Terminal Setup page appears.

entries.title: Saved card still asks for the CVV
steps: This is expected. The system does not save the CVV; it must be entered for each transaction.
entries.quote: The system does not save the card verification value (CVV), which must be entered for each transaction.

entries.title: Taxes are not applied automatically in Virtual Terminal
steps: Set up taxes and fees first under Settings > View all settings > Taxes & Fees.
The Payments Plus plan does not support automatically applied taxes and fees.
entries.quote: Note: The Payments Plus plan does not support automatically applied taxes and fees.

entries.title: Take a bank account (ACH) payment over the phone in Virtual Terminal
steps: Log in to the Clover dashboard.
Select New Sale, then Take payment under Transaction Type.
Enter the amount and choose checking or savings, business or personal.
Enter the customer's name, account number and routing number.
Enter the customer's identification and full address.
Select Complete Payment.
Read the consent language to the customer and record their responses.
Tick the acknowledgment box and select Submit.
entries.quote: After selecting Complete Payment, you must read the consent language to the customer and record the customer’s responses.

entries.title: Bank account (TeleCheck ACH) payments are not available
steps: TeleCheck ACH has to be activated on the account.
Contact support to activate it.
entries.quote: To activate TeleCheck ACH services for your Clover account, contact customer support.

entries.title: Create and send an invoice
steps: Log in to the Clover dashboard.
Select Sales activity > Invoices.
Select Create new invoice.
Select or add the customer and a payment due date.
Choose Quick charge and enter the amount, or Itemized invoice and add items.
Select Review and send.
Choose any extra delivery method (text message or share a link), then select Send.
entries.quote: Select Review and send to preview the invoice.

entries.title: Change or cancel an invoice after sending
steps: An unpaid invoice can be cancelled.
A paid invoice cannot be cancelled; issue a refund instead.
entries.quote: If the invoice is paid, instead of canceling, you must issue a refund to return funds to the customer.

entries.title: Cannot send an invoice by text message
steps: Text message delivery is only for US-based businesses on the Essentials plan and above.
The business must be enrolled in a toll-free number.
The customer needs a phone number on file.
entries.quote: Text message delivery: Sending invoices by text message (SMS) is available only for US-based businesses on the Essentials plan and above. You must be enrolled in a toll‑free number.

entries.title: View, print, share, remind or cancel an invoice
steps: Log in to the Clover dashboard.
Select Sales activity > Invoices.
Find the invoice by customer, or filter by date and status.
Select Options on the invoice.
Choose Send reminder, View invoice, Cancel invoice, Print invoice or Share invoice link.
entries.quote: In the search results table, for an invoice, select Options and then select:

entries.title: Invoice status shows 'Failed'
steps: There was a problem with the customer's payment.
Common reasons: insufficient funds, an expired card, risk and fraud concerns, or usage restrictions such as location or merchant type.
entries.quote: Common reasons include insufficient funds, an expired card, concerns about risk and fraud, or usage restrictions, such as location or merchant type.

entries.title: Invoice status shows 'Expired'
steps: The invoice is past its expiration date.
Invoices expire 180 days after creation.
entries.quote: Expired: Invoice is past the expiration date. Invoices expire 180 days after creation.

entries.title: Edit a pending invoice
steps: Log in to the Clover dashboard.
Select Sales activity > Invoices.
Open the invoice and select Edit (pencil icon).
Change items, taxes, due date or note.
Select Continue.
Tick 'Send an updated invoice' if wanted, then select Save changes.
entries.quote: Select the checkbox next to ‘Send an updated invoice’ to send the updated invoice.

entries.title: Send an invoice from the Clover Go app
steps: In the Clover Go app, select New Sale on the bottom bar.
Select Create invoice at the top right.
Select Add customer and choose or add the recipient.
Enter the amount and an optional note.
Set a payment due date and select Send invoice.
Check the invoice and select Send invoice, then Done.
entries.quote: In the top-right corner of the New Sale screen, select Create invoice to begin creating your invoice.

entries.title: 'Create invoice' is not available in Clover Go
steps: Create invoice is not available when there are items in the cart.
Either empty the cart, or check out: select Take payment, then More options, then 'Send as an invoice'.
entries.quote: Note: If you have any items in your cart, Create invoice is not available.

entries.title: Create a recurring payment plan
steps: Log in to the Clover dashboard.
Select Sales activity > Recurring Payments.
Select Create New Payment Plan.
Enter the plan name, default subtotal and frequency.
Tick 'Activate plan' to enable billing.
Save.
entries.quote: Select the Activate plan checkbox to enable billing.

entries.title: Put a customer on a recurring payment plan
steps: Log in to the Clover dashboard.
Select New Sale.
Under Transaction type, select Recurring payment.
Select the payment plan.
Add or find the customer and enter their card (with their permission to keep it on file).
Set the start date and optional end date.
Select Create Recurring Payment.
entries.quote: Under Transaction type, select Recurring payment.

entries.title: Pause a recurring payment plan
steps: Log in to the Clover dashboard.
Select Sales Activity > Recurring Payments.
Find the plan and select Options > Pause.
Confirm.
Billing stops for all customers on the plan until it is reactivated.
entries.quote: Pausing a recurring payment plan suspends billing for all customers on the plan until you reactivate the plan.

entries.title: Cannot delete a recurring payment plan
steps: Only plans with no active subscriptions can be deleted.
Deleting a plan removes all plan information; customer invoices stay under Invoices.
entries.quote: You can only delete plans that don't have active subscriptions.

entries.title: Before taking payments in the Clover Go app
steps: The app needs iOS 11 or higher, or Android 6 or higher.
Turn on location sharing.
Check tip preferences and signature options in the dashboard.
entries.quote: Turn on location sharing: Clover uses the location of transactions to protect against fraudulent activity.

entries.title: Clover Go card reader does not offer tips
steps: Card readers are preset to either accept or reject tips.
If the reader is not preset to accept tips, contact support.
entries.quote: If your card reader isn't preset to accept tips and you want to accept them, contact customer support.

entries.title: Log in to the Clover Go app
steps: Open the app and tap Get Started.
Enter the Clover account email and password and tap Log In.
If two-factor authentication is on, enter the code sent to the device.
If there are several locations, tap one and tap Continue.
Enter the passcode for the Clover account.
entries.quote: Enter the passcode associated with your Clover account. The Home screen appears.

entries.title: Find your passcode
steps: Log in to the Clover dashboard.
Select Employees > Employee List.
Select your name, then Edit Employee. The profile shows the passcode.
entries.quote: Select your name from the list and select Edit Employee to display your employee profile and your passcode.

entries.title: Forgot the password in the Clover Go app
steps: On the login screen, tap Forgot Password.
A password reset is sent to the Clover account email.
entries.quote: If you don't have your password, tap Forgot Password, and we'll send a password reset to your Clover account email.

entries.title: Clover Go asks for email and password again
steps: After the first login, only the passcode (or fingerprint or face) is normally needed.
After logging out, or after 7 days without using the app, a full login with email, password and passcode is required again.
The app may also ask to pick from a grid of images.
entries.quote: If you log out of the Go app or don't use it for seven (7) days, you'll need to log in again with your email and password, passcode, and any fingerprint or facial recognition you've set up.

entries.title: Switch location in the Clover Go app
steps: Go G2 on a phone: on the Home screen, tap the current location at the top, then tap the location you want.
Go G1: tap Menu at the top left, tap Switch Location, choose the location, then choose whether it is the primary location or just for this session.
entries.quote: On the Home screen, tap the current location at the top of the screen to display a list of locations.

entries.title: Switch users in the Clover Go app
steps: Go G2: from the More menu tap Settings, tap Log Out and confirm, then the other user logs in with their email, password and passcode.
Go G1: tap Menu, tap Log Out, tap Switch User, pick the user and enter their passcode.
entries.quote: From the Settings screen, tap Log Out and confirm that you want to log out.

entries.title: Clover Go does not recognize the email and password
steps: This may be because there are multiple Clover accounts.
If you have logged in to this account before, tap Returning User and select your name.
If you are new on this account, enter your dashboard login email and password.
If the password is not accepted, tap Access your Account and enter the account email to get a reset email.
entries.quote: If the Go app doesn't recognize your email address and password, it may be because you have multiple Clover accounts.

entries.title: Clover Go does not recognize the passcode
steps: If you have logged in before, tap Switch User and select your name from the list.
If you do not remember the passcode, have the manager reset it from the dashboard.
entries.quote: If you don't remember your passcode, have your manager reset your passcode from the dashboard.

entries.title: Clover Go will not log in: usual causes
steps: Login problems on the Go app are typically about the email, password or passcode tied to the Clover account.
entries.quote: Login issues on the Clover Go mobile app are typically related to the email, password, or passcode associated with your Clover account.

entries.title: What Tap to Pay on iPhone needs
steps: The account owner must enable it.
Surcharging must not be enabled on the account.
iPhone XS or later with iOS 16 or higher.
A device passcode set on the iPhone.
entries.quote: Have iPhone XS or later with iOS 16 or higher.

entries.title: Tap to Pay on iPhone is not available
steps: Tap to Pay on iPhone does not work on accounts with surcharging enabled; if surcharging is turned on later, it becomes unavailable.
The owner must have accepted Apple's terms; until then the button does not appear for employees.
The owner can enable it under More > Settings > Tap to Pay on iPhone.
entries.quote: If you enable surcharging later, Tap to Pay on iPhone becomes unavailable.

entries.title: Take a contactless payment with Tap to Pay on iPhone
steps: Open the Clover Go app and build the order.
Select Tap to Pay on iPhone.
Turn the iPhone toward the customer.
The customer holds their card flat at the top of the iPhone over the contactless symbol for a few seconds, or taps their phone or watch there.
When the check mark appears the transaction is complete.
entries.quote: When the check mark appears, the transaction is complete.

entries.title: Use the PIN Entry Aid on a Flex
steps: At the Enter PIN screen, place the PIN Entry Aid on top of the Flex and wrap its corners around the corners of the device.
If the customer prefers credit, press Skip and remove the aid.
Give the Flex to the customer to enter their PIN.
A tone tells them the PIN was submitted and the card can be removed.
Remove the aid and complete the transaction.
entries.quote: Wrap the corners of the PIN Entry Aid around the corners of the Flex.

entries.title: Use the PIN Entry Aid on a Mini 3
steps: At the Enter PIN screen, press the Accessible PIN entry button.
Place the PIN Entry Aid on the device, top edge lined up with the top of the screen.
Rotate the screen toward the customer to enter their PIN.
A tone tells them the PIN was submitted.
Rotate the Mini back, remove the aid and continue.
To go without the aid at any time, press 'Use screen'.
entries.quote: Press the Accessible PIN entry button on your Mini 3 when you reach the Enter PIN screen during your transaction.

entries.title: Accessibility mode for PIN entry on a Flex
steps: On the Present card screen, activate the Accessibility mode option.
The device speaks the amount and asks the cardholder to tap or insert the card.
After the card is inserted the customer slides a finger down the screen to hear each option and double-taps to choose it.
Options: enter PIN on screen with speech, Chip & PIN with tactile overlay, or practice mode.
Audio plays through wired headphones if connected, otherwise the speaker.
entries.quote: On the Present card screen, activate the Accessibility mode option for the cardholder.

entries.title: Accessibility mode is missing on an older Flex
steps: Accessibility mode is on Flex 3, Flex 4 and Flex Pocket.
It is not available on Flex 1 or Flex 2.
entries.quote: Accessibility mode is not available on Flex 1 or Flex 2.

entries.title: Practice mode speaks the digits aloud
steps: In practice mode every digit entered is spoken aloud.
Customers must never use their real PIN in practice mode.
entries.quote: Note: Customers must never use their real PIN during practice mode, as all digits entered in training mode are spoken aloud through the audio interface.

entries.title: Find a table or order on a Flex (Clover Dining)
steps: Open Clover Dining on the Flex.
Select the search icon at the top right.
Search by table name, order ID, order number, order note, customer name or last 4 digits of the card.
Select the table or order, or start a new order.
entries.quote: Search by table name, order ID, order #, order note, customer name, or last 4 digits on card.
